audit: Find duplicated mechanisms and unnecessary layers

delegation.reason: Human explicitly selected Sol medium for finite caller/duplication investigations; focused known-goal source review. Subagents and independent finite challenges use that setting; no claim about root runtime model.

tooling.screen: TypeScript5.9.3 syntax-only token fingerprints and single-return-call seeds; no package code imported or executed. Static tokens do not resolve scopes/effects or prove equivalence. Nested bodies overlap. Rust preludes reviewed manually.
tooling.verification: Frozen git source hashes/ranges/alias/count/caller anchors; package-current equality; no build/test/install/benchmark/runtime qualification.

exclusions: Product implementation, dependency/manifest/backend changes, adoption/retirement and deployment
Compiler edits, shared decisions/living filetree edits, supervision or runtime resources
Exhaustive whole-repository semantic proof, external consumers or dynamic/deployed reachability
decision_status: Conditional proposals and retained boundaries, not accepted new semantic policies. Consequential future profile/migration choices retain JEV/owner handoff gates.
